## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 According to DharmaNexus data, the text shares extensive material within the Pali canon and its commentaries: verses §14.1–17.2 correspond directly to verses in the *Cūḷapanthakattheragāthā* (Thag 10.4, §1.1–4.2), and extensive portions of the poem (particularly §0.3–20.1) are quoted or shared with the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, recurring formulaic sections, notably around §19.3–21.1, are shared with numerous other poems in the *Therāpadāna*, such as the *Piṇḍolabhāradvājattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 10), *Subhūtittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 23), *Aññāsikoṇḍaññattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 9), and *Upālittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 8) [DharmaNexus]. Beyond Pali literature, DharmaNexus detects cross-language alignments with Buddhist Sanskrit texts, including the *Kaṭhināvadāna* and *Divyāvadāna*, as well as Tibetan canonical texts such as the *Amitābhavyūha-nāma-mahāyāna-sūtra* and Vinaya commentaries [DharmaNexus].
